follow_ups.title: Fix dotnet format whitespace and charset violations in CatalogApi.cs
follow_ups.reason: dotnet format --verify-no-changes reports WHITESPACE at lines 401 and 418 and CHARSET at line 1, none of them in this story's lines; a format check over the whole file in CI will fail.

follow_ups.title: GetItemById/UpdateItem return ProblemDetails with application/json content type
follow_ups.reason: They use BadRequest<ProblemDetails>/NotFound<ProblemDetails>, which send plain JSON while the OpenAPI docs say application/problem+json, so clients and contract tests checking the media type get the wrong one.
